item.title: Deer Lakes boys get physical, drop section champ Derry in Class 4A 1st round
item.description: High school basketball coaches often say the end of the first half and the beginning of the second half is the most crucial time of the game.

item.title: Lyla Jablon keeps her cool, helps Fox Chapel advance past Latrobe in Class 5A 1st round
item.description: Fox Chapel girls basketball coach Marty Matvey believes guard Lyla Jablon won’t wilt at the first sign of trouble. During her four seasons with the Foxes, she has been challenged by Matvey to be ready for the tough moments.

item.title: Penn-Trafford girls finally shake loose vs. Franklin Regional in WPIAL 5A 1st round
item.description: On a night when the rims were tight and shots weren’t falling, Penn-Trafford had to get used to some initial discomfort before it could find its footing in the playoff opener.

item.title: 12th-seeded Peters Township girls come together for upset win over No. 5 Plum
item.description: Despite his team’s fourth-place finish in Section 4-5A and being slotted as the No. 12 seed for the WPIAL playoffs, Peters Township girls basketball coach Steve Limberiou felt confident a rugged section and overall schedule and strong play down the stretch in the regular season would translate into good things once the postseason started.

item.title: A lawsuit seeks to stop Trump’s overhaul of a 100-year-old public golf course in Washington
item.description: Two golfers in Washington, D.C., sued the federal government on Friday to try to prevent the Trump administration from overhauling a more than 100-year-old public golf course, accusing the administration of violating environmental laws and polluting a park that is on the National Register of Historic Places.

item.title: Minor league report: Nailers shut out by Royals
item.description: Goaltender Taylor Gauthier made 26 saves on 28 shots for the Wheeling Nailers in a 3-0 loss to the Reading Royals at WesBanco Arena in Wheeling, W.Va., on Friday.

item.title: High school roundup for Feb. 13, 2026: Mimi Thiero nets 30 in Quaker Valley’s 1st round victory
item.description: Mimi Thiero hit for 30 points to power No. 4 Quaker Valley to a 50-36 victory over No. 13 Keystone Oaks in the WPIAL Class 3A girls basketball first round Friday night.

item.title: White House orders Homeland Security shutdown as funding lapses
item.description: WASHINGTON — The White House ordered the Department of Homeland Security to begin shutdown procedures as its funding from Congress expires at midnight — the third time parts of the U.S. government will have shut down in the past six months.
